title: FRIDAY ARMS + CORE
subtitle: FRIDAY. ARMS AND CORE. OPEN THE BACK, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN PRESS AND HOLD HONEST. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. FRIDAY. FRIDAY ARMS AND CORE. FIFTEEN MINUTES. OPEN THE BACK, OWN THE BALANCE, THEN PRESS AND HOLD HONEST. DO NOT HIDE BEHIND THAT KEYBOARD, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. FRIDAY ARMS AND CORE DONE. PRESS HONEST. CORE AWAKE. NOW GET BACK TO THAT DESK AND EARN YOUR KEEP.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: SCAPULAR ROW
exercises.cue: STAND TALL OR HINGE LIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN SLOW. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH AND POSTURE OPENER. NO YANKING.
exercises.speakStart: SCAPULAR ROWS. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. PULL THE SHOULDER BLADES BACK AND DOWN. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. OPEN THE BACK AFTER THAT DESK. DO NOT YANK LIKE YOU ARE STARTING A LAWNMOWER.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE SHOULDERS LOOSE.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. CHEST UP. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR IF YOU NEED IT. OWN THE BALANCE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. STEP BACK. CHEST UP. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT WOBBLE ABOUT LIKE A BLOODY WEATHERVANE.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UP
exercises.cue: FIFTH STAIR. HANDS ON THE STEP. BODY STRAIGHT. LOWER WITH CONTROL. PRESS UP CLEAN. DO NOT DROP THE STEP.
exercises.speakStart: INCLINE PUSH UPS. FIFTH STAIR. THREE SETS OF EIGHT. HANDS ON THE STEP. BODY STRAIGHT. LOWER WITH CONTROL. THIS IS YOUR ARM WORK. DO NOT CHEAT THE DEPTH, YOU LAZY SOD.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE ARMS. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: DEAD BUG
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. LOW BACK PRESSED DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG REACH SLOW. BREATHE. CONTROL BEATS SPEED.
exercises.speakStart: DEAD BUGS. TWO SETS. SIX EACH SIDE. LOW BACK DOWN. OPPOSITE ARM AND LEG. SLOW. THIS IS YOUR CORE WORK. DO NOT FLOP LIKE A PANICKED BEETLE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE CORE QUIET.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS. HIPS LEVEL. DRIVE THE KNEES IN CLEAN BURSTS. STEADY BREATH. ARMS AND CORE TOGETHER. QUALITY BEATS SPEED.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS EACH. HANDS SET. HIPS LEVEL. DRIVE THE KNEES. THIS IS YOUR ARMS AND CORE WORK. DO NOT FLOP ABOUT LIKE A PANICKED SPIDER.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. STACK THE HIPS. HOLD ABOUT FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. SHORT AND HONEST. DO NOT CHASE TWENTY.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANKS. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEE DOWN IS FINE. STACK THE HIPS. SHORT HOLD. THIS IS YOUR CORE FINISH. DO NOT SHAKE LIKE A LEAF IN A GALE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE CORE QUIET. I'M WATCHING.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
